what: acceptance-public-surfaces allows an integration test to drive a public library function besides the CLI, HTTP or UI.
why: Owner rule after the Fieldnote run (Tom, 2026-10-20, PR #54): integration tests may enter through a public library function, e.g. Fieldnote's build_context(); end-to-end tests and just qc still go through the CLI, HTTP or UI. ADR 0002 was rewritten in place and the spec followed it (owner yes: Tom, 2026-10-20).
evidence: Fieldnote run: a target whose public surface is a library function could not be integration-tested under 'the test drives the app's CLI, HTTP or UI and calls no internal function', which contradicted rewritten ADR 0002.

what: An owed eval is listed in its own file under docs/owed-evals/ instead of docs/future.md; the criterion's requirement (a smoke in evidence/ and a listed owed eval until just qa runs it) is unchanged.
why: Owner, issue #80 (finding 50): every lane appending to docs/future.md made nearly every pair of open PRs conflict there (#49/#73, #49/#78, #73/#78, #27/#35, #27/#31). ADR 0008 and check-behavior-smoke move to docs/owed-evals/ in the same PR; the spec follows.
evidence: Two contradicting lines once this PR lands: docs/adr/0008-prose-last.md (corrected in place, issue #80) and scripts/check-behavior-smoke require a docs/owed-evals/*.md change, while quality#acceptance-prompt-eval and #quality-prompt-smoke said docs/future.md.

what: just check in the kit no longer checks GitHub-only references: the Linear ban leaves check-refs.
why: Owner ruling (Tom, 2026-10-22, issue #82): feather works with Linear directly so it can run on Turbo-Outreach; the tracker is set per target in .octo-feather.toml, tracker work lives in packaged skills (github-pr, github-issues, linear) behind fixed script names, and ADR 0004 and 0011 were corrected in place to match.
evidence: Corrected ADR 0004 says the tracker is GitHub Issues or Linear, chosen per target, and ADR 0011 that a Linear lane's key is its lowercased ticket key, while the spec as accepted says 'Pi-only and GitHub-only references' (recipe-check); the accepted criteria cannot pass on a Linear target, which Turbo-Outreach is.
